title: Kissed Spicy Malaysian Chicken Satay
description: A flavorful and spicy Malaysian dish featuring chicken satay cooked in a mixture of spices and wrapped in pandan leaves, this recipe is a unique blend of grassy and shattering flavors, with the crunch of raw-friendly ingredients and the aroma of tandoor, all in one pot, using pandan leaf wraps as the vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the mixed spice blend, tandoor paste, and coconut milk.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Wrap each piece of chicken in a pandan leaf, securing with a toothpick if needed.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the wrapped chicken pieces to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve the chicken satay hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
